subject: GlowHealth on-camera advocate checklist & logistics
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@glowhealth.com>, Nick Ruiz <nick.ruiz@glowhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: GlowHealth on-camera advocate checklist & logistics

Hi Emily / Nick —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a quick customer spotlight video with us. We want to keep this friendly and low-lift for your team. Proposed plan below — please flag anything that won't work.

Quick ask: are you comfortable with a 6–8 minute on-camera conversation focused on: the problem you were solving, why you chose Redwood Inference, and one concrete metric or outcome? We can stitch in B-roll/screenshots and minimize on-site time.

Proposed schedule:
- Filming: half-day (3–4 hours) on Wed, Oct 6 or Fri, Oct 8 (we can do remote via Zoom if preferred)
- Pre-brief call: 30 minutes to go over talking points (week of Sep 21)
- Deliverables: short highlight reel (2 min), full interview (6–8 min), and a one-page quote for press

I've attached a draft talking-points script and a simple itinerary. Monica from CS will coordinate logistics and release paperwork. Markus (marketing) will handle story framing and final approvals.

If you're good with the high level, I can send a DocuSign for the release and lock a slot on our crew calendar.

Thanks — excited to feature GlowHealth!

—
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Advocate | Redwood Inference
mailto:rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clear plan. Were interested but have a couple constraints:

1) Our legal team needs to review the release language before we confirm anything on camera. Please send over the release PDF (we have in-house counsel copied).
2) Were short-staffed the week of Oct 4; Oct 8 would be preferred, and wed like to do a remote interview over a high-quality Zoom link rather than in-person.

Also, our VP of Product (Nick) wants the final questions up front so he can prepare examples. Can you share the talking points and an interview flow?

Emily Carter
Head of Growth, GlowHealth

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GlowHealth on-camera advocate checklist & logistics

Emily —

Attaching the release form and a more granular shoot itinerary (see attachments). The release is the standard Redwood participant release with a short usage window and an optional quote attribution clause. Legal is welcome to request edits; weve noted the key variables that can be struck or tightened (usage channels, duration, attribution).

Proposed interview flow (30 minute pre-brief, 45 minute interview):
- Quick intro & 1-min warmup
- Problem + prior state (3 minutes)
- Why Redwood / selection criteria (4 minutes)
- Implementation highlights / ops (6 minutes)
- Outcomes with a concrete metric (3 minutes)
- Rapid-fire favorite features & one-liner quote (3 minutes)
- Wrap + next steps (2 minutes)

Logistics notes:
- We'll provide a producer to run the recording and do light editing; you only need one subject on camera and one backup for additional soundbites.
- We will send a short pre-interview questionnaire to help shape the story.

If legal approves the release we can send a DocuSign link today. Rachel — Ill coordinate the calendar for Oct 8 remote slot (Pacific morning).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@glowhealth.com>

Subject: Re: GlowHealth on-camera advocate checklist & logistics

Emily —

Thanks — attaching the updated talking-points script (talking_points_script_draft_v3.docx) with optional prompts for Nick. Ive also uploaded a small reference pack with sample clips from other customers so you can see the style: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GLOW-CASE-STUDY

Per Monicas note, heres the DocuSign link for the release if legal is ready: https://www.docusign.com/sign/Glow-Health-Release-GLW4521

Key callouts in the release we can negotiate:
- Usage: web, social, and sales collateral (we can limit to "web and case study" if needed)
- Attribution: full name and title vs company-only option
- Expiration: default 3 years, can be shortened

If youre comfortable, sign the DocuSign and Monica will lock the Oct 8 10:00 AM PT slot. If not, tell us which clause you want changed and well route to legal.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Customer Advocate | Redwood Inference
